statement: Pinned etale reconstruction is not full over any algebraic extension of a finite field, any infinite perfect field with nontrivial center of its absolute Galois group (including all real closed fields), or any algebraically closed field.

notes: Explicit framed-point map a -> z(a) distinguishes central comparison twists. Infinite fixed sets force any localized polynomial to be the identity. For algebraic finite-field bases the topos morphisms are uncountable but perfection-polynomials are countable. Algebraically closed fields have semilinear automorphisms fixing an infinite subfield.
